d:
The all-new Hyundai Bayon is officially here! Slotted right between the sub-4-metre Venue and the massive Creta, this crossover is built specifically to give you the perfect middle ground.
In this QuickEase walkaround, Saneet Dsilva breaks down the hand-me-down 1.5-litre four-cylinder Creta engine that delivers smooth refinement, the automatic iVT's secret "Dash Boost Mode", and a 411-litre boot that easily outperforms the Venue.
